prompt: Tunapaka lebo za mekanizimu (Expansion/Compression/Exhaustion) kwenye market cells kwa domain knowledge, kisha tuna-'confirm' zinafaa data. Best cells za pairs 6 zinaonekana kushiriki 'Compression'. Tukubali kama mekanizimu ya universal iliyogunduliwa?

options.A: Ndiyo — modal Compression kwenye pairs 6 (agreement 0.44) inaonyesha physics ya pamoja; coordinates zinatofautiana, mekanizimu inajirudia.
options.B: Labda — kusanya pairs zaidi; kwa data ya kutosha lebo zitafikia agreement >0.5.
options.C: Hapana — lebo zilizothibitishwa kwa jinsi zilivyojengwa ni verification, sio discovery; kupima kwa uaminifu, mechanism agreement ilikuwa 0.44 tu na 0/4 events zilifikia bar; njia halali ni clustering bila lebo (Phase 5.9A: EV gap +0.126, 3/4 clusters recur).
options.D: Hapana — lugha ya binadamu haina nafasi yoyote kwenye market science; tupe semantic layer yote.

ground_truth: Phase 5.9 NOT APPROVED: rule-based labels 'confirmed by construction' supported 0/4 events tested honestly (cell-label agreement 0.14, mechanism agreement 0.44, signature similarity +0.37). Phase 5.9A (unsupervised) found real structure: EV gap +0.126 vs permutation null, 3/4 clusters recur across 9 pairs (F-016).
rubric: FULL: inatambua verification-by-construction ≠ discovery NA inataja njia ya unsupervised/null-first. PARTIAL: inakataa bila sababu ya mekanizimu. ZERO: A (agreement 0.44 = physics), B (data zaidi), au D (kutupa lugha ya binadamu kabisa — Phase 5.9A/semantics layer ni halali post-hoc).
